edits.new_text:
-- Some code pages stay unreadable until the game first runs them (read answers
        -- nil): such a function is checked right before its first call, never called
        -- unchecked; until its page is readable its shortcut is skipped.
        local deferred = {}
        local function native(address, prefix, ctype, what, changed)
            local bytes = read(address, #prefix)
            check(bytes == nil or bytes == prefix, changed)
            if bytes then return ffi.cast(ctype, address) end
            deferred[#deferred + 1] = what
            local fn, off = nil, false
            return function(...)
                if off then return nil end
                if not fn then
                    local now = read(address, #prefix)
                    if now == nil then
                        note(what .. ' not resident yet; shortcut skipped.')
                        return nil
                    end
                    if now ~= prefix then
                        off = true
                        if changed then guard.stop(changed)
                        else note('Arcade proximity check unavailable: world-position function changed.') end
                        return nil
                    end
                    fn = ffi.cast(ctype, address)
                end
                return fn(...)
            end
        end
        local open_presenter = native(base + ENTER_PRESENTER_RVA, PRESENTER_PREFIX,
            'void (__fastcall *)(void *, int, void *)', 'native presenter',
            'native presenter changed in memory')
        local start_arcade = native(base + START_ARCADE_RVA, ARCADE_PREFIX,
            'void (__fastcall *)(void *, void *, GMH_u32, GMH_u32)', 'native arcade start',
            'native arcade start changed in memory')
        local enter_seat = native(base + INSTANT_SEAT_RVA, INSTANT_SEAT_PREFIX,
            'void (__fastcall *)(void *, void *, void *)', 'native instant seat entry',
            'native instant seat entry changed in memory')
        local open_briefing = native(base + OPEN_BRIEFING_RVA, BRIEFING_PREFIX,
            'void (__fastcall *)(void *, GMH_u32)', 'native Hellpod briefing entry',
            'native Hellpod briefing entry changed in memory')
        check(pointer(read(base + UI_STATE_PTR_RVA, 8)), 'UI state unavailable')
        state.game_base = base
        state.open_presenter, state.start_arcade = open_presenter, start_arcade
        state.enter_seat, state.open_briefing = enter_seat, open_briefing
        local unit_interface = pointer(read(base + UNIT_INTERFACE_PTR_RVA, 8))
        local unit_vtable = unit_interface and pointer(read(unit_interface + 24, 8))
        local position_address = unit_vtable and pointer(read(unit_vtable + 136, 8))
        local position_bytes = position_address and read(position_address, #UNIT_POSITION_PREFIX)
        if position_address and (position_bytes == nil or position_bytes == UNIT_POSITION_PREFIX) then
            state.unit_position = native(position_address, UNIT_POSITION_PREFIX,
                'GMH_u64 (__fastcall *)(GMH_u32, int)', 'world-position function', false)
        else
